    AvgScrWrite
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f."Charter School Number", 
        s.AvgScrWrite,

    FROM satscores s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND f."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT 
    "School", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)", 
    "SAT Participation", 
    "High Scorers (>=1500)"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.School, 
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
        f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
        ss.NumTstTakr AS "SAT Participation",
        ss.NumGE1500 AS "High Scorers (>=1500)"
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
        AND s."CDSCode" IN (
            SELECT 
                f2."CDSCode" 
            FROM 
                schools s2
            JOIN 
                frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
            WHERE 
                s2.SOC = '66'
            ORDER BY 
                f2."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
            LIMIT 5
        )
) AS top_schools
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC;

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    (SELECT 
         g.Country,
         g.GasStationID
     FROM 
         transactions_1k t
     JOIN 
         gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
     JOIN 
         (SELECT 
              g.Country,
              g.Segment,
              t.ProductID,
              AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
          FROM 
              transactions_1k t
          JOIN 
              gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
          GROUP BY 
              g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID) avg_prices
     ON 
         g.Country = avg_prices.Country 
         AND g.Segment = avg_prices.Segment 
         AND t.ProductID = avg_prices.ProductID
     WHERE 
         t.Price < avg_prices.AvgPrice
     GROUP BY 
         g.Country, g.GasStationID) value_for_money
GROUP BY 
    Country;

SELECT region, 
       total_gold_cards_in_region,
       gold_cards_before_1998_in_region,
       (gold_cards_before_1998_in_region * 100.0 / total_gold_cards_in_region) AS percentage_before_1998
FROM (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards_in_region,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998_in_region
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY d.A3
) AS region_data;

-- Overall percentage
SELECT (SUM(gold_cards_before_1998_in_region) * 100.0 / SUM(total_gold_cards_in_region)) AS overall_percentage_before_1998
FROM (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards_in_region,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998_in_region
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY d.A3
) AS region_data;

SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS total_loans_table
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS no_issues_loans_table
     ON 
        total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
        AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category);

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG((completed_races * 100.0) / total_races), 2) AS completion_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS total_races, 
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN res.raceId END) AS completed_races
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Japan' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    GROUP BY d.driverId
) AS subquery;

           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN res.raceId END) AS completed_races
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Japan' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

);

    GROUP BY base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id
)

    atom_count
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
ORDER BY atom_count DESC

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;
